explication: MemOS is a memory system for LLM agents, offered as a hosted API, self-hosted service, and agent plugins. The main workflow accepts agent or application memory operations, searches or updates memory, and returns context; asynchronous ingestion and memory evolution add background stages. The graph also preserves the documented multi-cube, feedback, multimodal, and skill capabilities. Some subsystem links reflect README descriptions and the file tree rather than inspected implementations, so uncertain internal wiring is omitted.
